sections.title: NPV計算の手順
sections.content:
<svg viewBox='0 0 400 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' style='font-family:Noto Sans JP,sans-serif'><text x='200' y='16' text-anchor='middle' font-size='12' font-weight='700' fill='currentColor'>NPV計算のステップ</text><rect x='11' y='28' width='72' height='50' rx='8' fill='var(--guide-soft)' stroke='var(--guide)' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='47' y='48' text-anchor='middle' font-size='12' font-weight='700' fill='currentColor'>①初期投資</text><text x='47' y='64' text-anchor='middle' font-size='9' fill='var(--ink-2)'>設備＋運転資本</text><path d='M87,53 L109,53' stroke='var(--drop)' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/><path d='M105,49 L111,53 L105,57' fill='var(--drop)'/><rect x='113' y='28' width='72' height='50' rx='8' fill='var(--guide-soft)' stroke='var(--guide)' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='149' y='48' text-anchor='middle' font-size='12' font-weight='700' fill='currentColor'>②年間CF</text><text x='149' y='64' text-anchor='middle' font-size='9' fill='var(--ink-2)'>利益+償却費</text><path d='M189,53 L211,53' stroke='var(--drop)' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/><path d='M207,49 L213,53 L207,57' fill='var(--drop)'/><rect x='215' y='28' width='72' height='50' rx='8' fill='var(--guide-soft)' stroke='var(--guide)' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='251' y='48' text-anchor='middle' font-size='12' font-weight='700' fill='currentColor'>③現在価値</text><text x='251' y='64' text-anchor='middle' font-size='9' fill='var(--ink-2)'>係数で割引</text><path d='M291,53 L313,53' stroke='var(--drop)' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/><path d='M309,49 L315,53 L309,57' fill='var(--drop)'/><rect x='317' y='28' width='72' height='50' rx='8' fill='var(--guide-soft)' stroke='var(--guide)' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='353' y='48' text-anchor='middle' font-size='12' font-weight='700' fill='currentColor'>④NPV判定</text><text x='353' y='64' text-anchor='middle' font-size='9' fill='var(--ink-2)'>＞0なら投資</text></svg>

<svg viewBox='0 0 440 116' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' style='font-family:Noto Sans JP,sans-serif'><text x='220' y='18' text-anchor='middle' font-size='13' font-weight='700' fill='currentColor'>年間CFの計算（2つの公式）</text><line x1='10' y1='30' x2='430' y2='30' stroke='currentColor' stroke-width='1'/><text x='120' y='48' text-anchor='middle' font-size='11' font-weight='700' fill='var(--drop)'>公式</text><text x='340' y='48' text-anchor='middle' font-size='11' font-weight='700' fill='var(--drop)'>計算式</text><line x1='10' y1='58' x2='430' y2='58' stroke='currentColor' stroke-width='0.5'/><text x='18' y='75' text-anchor='start' font-size='11' font-weight="700" fill='currentColor'>公式A（利益ベース）</text><text x='340' y='75' text-anchor='middle' font-size='11' fill='currentColor'>税引後利益＋減価償却費</text><line x1='10' y1='82' x2='430' y2='82' stroke='currentColor' stroke-width='0.3' stroke-dasharray='3 3'/><text x='18' y='99' text-anchor='start' font-size='11' font-weight="700" fill='currentColor'>公式B（CF直接法）</text><text x='340' y='99' text-anchor='middle' font-size='11' fill='currentColor'>(売上増−現金支出増)×(1−税率)＋減価償却費×税率</text></svg>

取替投資の注意点：
- 旧設備の帳簿価額＝取得原価−累計償却額
- 売却損＝帳簿価額−売却額 → 節税効果＝売却損×税率
- 運転資本の増減は発生時と回収時の両方でCFに影響
- 据置年金：年金現価係数×複利現価係数で据え置いた分を割引く
